title: A fix verifier at the reviewed head stands in for round 2
why: parse_review demands rounds 1, 2, 3 in a row. A lane whose path is round 1 FAIL, fix verifier, round 3 must run a filler round 2 to post a record. That hit #3060 and #3116 on Nov 12-13. The cost is a wasted review round each time, and a record whose order does not match what happened.
note: Guard change, to a lane, red first. Before building, the lane reads rule roles-review-cap-three (rounds 1 and 2 fix the defect; a small fix gets a fix verifier) and decision pr-review-record, and names the sentence that lets a fix verifier count as round 2. If no sentence allows it, the lane asks first (outcomes-stale-decision-protocol). Step review-record-no-restart asked for this path at 03:01 CST, but #3116 did not cover it.
